comments.author: Suntion
comments.body_html:
All modifications can be controlled through the values under EnableFunction. Simply set the value for any unnecessary function to false. (Sometimes, you may need to exit the game and clear the local cache to see the changes. Some modifications may only take effect after completing at least one match.)

RaidTimeModify: A value of 3 means the match time for all maps will be multiplied by 3.

e.g.

Bigmap: 40min -> 120min

Factory4Day: 20min -> 60min

Shoreline: 45min -> 135min

…
